text: player
Begins With a Step
Mm-hm...! That aura feels just right! This is great! You must be {var:player_nickname}!
Well, if there's nothing else, I gotta run!
Wait, wait, wait!
Who... are you?
Where to? To do what?
Chi Lin
Ahem...! I am Chi Lin, the Lady of the Horse Palace. I come to these lands bearing blessings...
Ughhh, the formal talk is wearing me out! Look, I'm a deity! I grant wishes and offer blessings!
I-is that so...
...Well, that's the plan, anyway. For some reason, wishes for smooth sailing at work are surprisingly popular this year...
I've already got a mountain of work to do...! At this rate, I'll never finish collecting all these wishes!
Uh... sure, but how exactly do we go about collecting wishes?
Well, there's really only one way to do it... I have to go visit everyone, door-to-door!
And as for the blessings, I'll just infuse my divine power into some food and hand it out! It's a big holiday, after all – nobody's gonna say no to delicious treats!
Wait... Chi Lin, are you really running out to collect these wishes all by yourself?!
(Meanwhile, a certain someone from before was basically waiting for tributes to be delivered right to her doorstep...)
Huh? What's the matter?
Let me get this straight...! Even though you did just claim to be a deity or whatever...
What? You don't think I look like one? Oh... Hahaha... Well, I'm not really good at the whole serious thing!
I just can't get the hang of Li Yang's style... But as you can see, I'm still the real deal!
I'm not saying I don't believe you...
All you need me to do is plan your routes?
Great!
Exactly!
But won't it be difficult... collecting everyone's wishes by yourself?
That's why I'm asking for your help! Hehe, and getting to help a deity out is pretty cool, huh?
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, as the saying goes. When it comes to work, if you can start it, you can finish it!
So, I'd better saddle up and get going! Later, {var:player_nickname}!
Wait...! Let me at least explain how traffic lights work first! Heyyy!
So... Could you help me? Please? Even if it's just planning my routes around One Han City!
